decisions.reason: The source defines main-board contents and exclusions but does not change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, or connector placement.
The main-board architecture clarification does not change the power board's layer count or grounding strategy.
The source confirms the already-established main-board USB-C and standalone LDO behavior without changing its regulator, activation condition, powered rail, loads, source selection, or purpose.
Excluding power management from the main board is consistent with the existing AXP2101 power-management requirement and does not change its PMIC, rails, normal-operation role, or battery power path.
The source does not alter DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or its role as the normal-operation 3.3V source.
A complete same-message INTRODUCE already records the main-board JST reset connector, so no additional or corrected MODIFY is required.
Mentioning pull-ups and series resistors among main-board passives is consistent with the existing locations and conditioning policy and establishes no changed value.
The statement that sensors are on another board is consistent with the sensor board's existing connector-hub role and does not change that role.
The source confirms that the main board has a power-board JST connector but does not change its connector type, pin count, matching rule, or pin-order policy.
The generic reference to LED JST connectors does not specifically change the charge-status connector, resistor, LED population, or indication path.
Identifying the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 as a main-board component does not change any current GPIO assignment or candidate-pin restriction.
The main-board exclusion of power management is consistent with the switched 5V rail residing in the separate power system and does not change its GPIO, converter, loads, control behavior, or rating.
